# vgi-bls

Retrieve labor, employment, price and productivity series with period codes, footnotes, calculations and survey metadata. Use a bls_api secret with api_key or BLS_API_KEY for registered access. Unregistered access has lower limits. Request explicit years and series identifiers; period codes retain annual averages and non-monthly frequencies without inventing dates. NULL arguments are rejected. Missing optional response fields return NULL. Upstream errors fail the query; SQL WHERE filters are local.

Queries use bounded HTTP responses and retries. Credentials stay out of continuation state. See README.md for deployment and operational limits.
